phrases.sealing_stalled: Sealing for {minutes} min, longer than usual. It waits while you record or while the headset is hot.
phrases.ready_action: Press the menu button to start
phrases.ready_local_action: Press the menu button to record. Nothing is delivered.
phrases.recording_action: Press the menu button to stop

seal_video_gap.headline: Last episode not kept: the {side} {camera} camera skipped frames
seal_video_gap.still_fine: The rig and your earlier episodes are fine.
seal_video_gap.action: Record it again. If it happens twice in a row, call a technician.

seal_controller_frozen.headline: Last episode not kept: the {side} controller stopped tracking
seal_controller_frozen.still_fine: The cameras and grippers recorded fine.
seal_controller_frozen.action: Keep both controllers awake and in view of the headset, then record again.

seal_head_cameras_out_of_step.headline: Last episode not kept: the head cameras fell out of step
seal_head_cameras_out_of_step.still_fine: The wrist cameras and grippers recorded fine.
seal_head_cameras_out_of_step.action: Restart the app so the display runs at 90 Hz, then record again.

seal_gripper_timing.headline: Last episode not kept: the {side} gripper sensor's timing was off
seal_gripper_timing.action: Record again. If it repeats, a technician checks the {side} gripper sensor.

seal_clock_coverage.headline: Last episode not kept: the headset's tracking clock had gaps
seal_clock_coverage.action: Record again. If it repeats, call a technician.

seal_device_info_missing.headline: Last episode not kept: the headset's camera details were missing
seal_device_info_missing.action: Restart the app and record again. If it repeats, call a technician.

seal_quality.headline: Last episode not kept: it did not pass the quality check
seal_quality.action: Record again. If it repeats, call a technician.

video_behind.headline: Last episode stopped: the {side} wrist camera video could not keep up
video_behind.action: Let the headset cool for a few minutes, then record again. If it repeats, call a technician.

gripper_link_lost.headline: Last episode stopped: the {side} gripper sensor lost its connection
gripper_link_lost.still_fine: The cameras and controllers are fine.
gripper_link_lost.action: Reseat the {side} gripper sensor's cable at the hub, then press Check.

device_disconnected.headline: Last episode stopped: the {side} {part} came unplugged
device_disconnected.action: Plug it back in firmly at the hub, then press Check.

usb_bandwidth.headline: The USB hub ran out of bandwidth
usb_bandwidth.action: Put both wrist cameras on one powered hub, then press Check.

recording_interrupted.headline: Last episode stopped: the app closed while recording
recording_interrupted.action: Keep the app open while you record.

device_missing.headline: The {side} {part} is not plugged in
device_missing.action: Plug it into the hub, then press Check.

usb_other_app.headline: Another app holds the {side} {part}
usb_other_app.action: Replug it and choose OpenQuestCapture when Android asks.

usb_permission.headline: A rig device is waiting for USB access
usb_permission.action: Choose OpenQuestCapture when Android asks. If no prompt shows, replug the device.

rig_check_failed.headline: The rig's devices did not pass the check
rig_check_failed.action: Press Check and fix the device it names.

library_missing.headline: This app version cannot run the rig
library_missing.action: A technician installs an approved version.

rig_open_failed.headline: The rig did not start
rig_open_failed.action: Restart the app. If it repeats, call a technician.

app_paused.headline: The app was paused
app_paused.action: Put the headset on, keep the app open, then start again.

signed_out.headline: Nobody is signed in
signed_out.action: Tap Sign in and approve the code on your phone.

sign_in_pending.headline: Waiting for you to approve sign-in

not_enrolled.headline: This headset is not set up as a pod
not_enrolled.action: Scan the setup QR code from the Console.

no_task.headline: No task is assigned to this pod
no_task.action: The floor manager assigns a task to this pod in the Console.

no_episodes.headline: No episodes left in this task
no_episodes.action: The floor manager adds episodes or assigns a new task in the Console.

no_episodes_held.headline: No episodes free: {held} held by attempts awaiting review
no_episodes_held.action: The floor manager reviews them in the Console, or adds episodes.

build_not_accepted.headline: App version not approved
build_not_accepted.action: The floor manager approves the trial in the Console, or a technician installs an approved version.

rig_registration_changed.headline: The rig's registration changed
rig_registration_changed.action: A technician runs setup again from the Console.

readiness_clock.headline: The headset's clock is not synced
readiness_clock.action: Connect the headset to the floor Wi-Fi. The clock syncs by itself.

readiness_power.headline: The headset battery is too low to record
readiness_power.action: Plug the headset in to charge.

readiness_network.headline: The headset is not on the network
readiness_network.action: Connect the headset to the floor Wi-Fi.

readiness_heartbeat.headline: The Factory has not heard this headset recently
readiness_heartbeat.action: Keep the app open and the headset on Wi-Fi.

readiness_storage.headline: The headset is short of space
readiness_storage.still_fine: Delivered episodes free space by themselves.
readiness_storage.action: Keep the headset on Wi-Fi so uploads finish.

readiness_devices.headline: The rig's devices have not passed a check

readiness_rig.headline: This pod has no registered rig
readiness_rig.action: A technician registers the rig for this pod in the Console.

readiness_task.headline: This pod's task is not ready to record
readiness_task.action: The floor manager checks the task's setup in the Console.

readiness_other.headline: A Factory check is failing
readiness_other.action: Call a technician. The Console names the check.

storage_low.headline: Not enough space: {free_gb} GB free, {needed_gb} GB needed for the next episode
storage_low.still_fine: {uploads} episodes are waiting to upload and free space once delivered.
storage_low.action: Keep the headset on Wi-Fi so uploads finish, or delete exported recordings.

storage_low_backlog.headline: Not enough space: {free_gb} GB free, {needed_gb} GB needed ({next_gb} GB for the next episode, {backlog_gb} GB for {backlog} episodes still to seal)
storage_low_backlog.still_fine: {uploads} episodes are waiting to upload and free space once delivered.
storage_low_backlog.action: Keep the headset on Wi-Fi and idle so the seals finish and uploads free space, or delete exported recordings.

factory_unanswered.headline: The Factory did not answer. Nothing was recorded.
factory_unanswered.action: Check the headset's Wi-Fi, then start again.

factory_unheard_local.headline: The Factory is not answering. Recording continues on the headset.
factory_unheard_local.still_fine: Episodes are kept and sent when it reconnects.

factory_unheard.headline: The Factory is not answering
factory_unheard.action: Check the headset's Wi-Fi, then start again.

collection_unfinished.headline: A collection cannot finish yet
collection_unfinished.action: The floor manager checks it in the Console.

controller_not_tracked.headline: The {side} controller is not tracked
controller_not_tracked.action: Pick it up or press a button to wake it.

controller_disconnected.headline: The {side} controller is not connected
controller_disconnected.action: Hold its Meta button to turn it on.

controller_battery_low.headline: The {side} controller is at {percent}%
controller_battery_low.action: Swap its battery before the next episode.

display_rate.headline: The display runs at {hz} Hz, not 90 Hz
display_rate.action: Restart the app so it sets 90 Hz. At this rate the head cameras fall out of step.

storage_tight.headline: Space is tight: {free_gb} GB free, {needed_gb} GB needed for the next episode
storage_tight.still_fine: {uploads} episodes are waiting to upload and free space once delivered.
storage_tight.action: Keep the headset on Wi-Fi so uploads finish.

storage_tight_backlog.headline: Space is tight: {free_gb} GB free, {needed_gb} GB needed ({next_gb} GB for the next episode, {backlog_gb} GB for {backlog} episodes still to seal)
storage_tight_backlog.still_fine: {uploads} episodes are waiting to upload and free space once delivered.
storage_tight_backlog.action: Keep the headset on Wi-Fi and idle so the seals finish and uploads free space.

slots_held.headline: {held} episodes are held by attempts awaiting review
slots_held.action: The floor manager reviews them in the Console.
